attempts.summary: Configured ufw on node1 (Ubuntu 24.04) with default-deny incoming / allow outgoing, explicit allow rules for 22/tcp (SSH) and 8080/tcp, enabled the ufw systemd service for boot persistence, verified live behavior (SSH open, unrelated port 9999 refused), then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured pre-restart boot_id, issued `systemctl reboot`, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified ufw was active/enabled with the same rules and correct allow/reject behavior post-restart.
